scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run dev --prefix apps/web" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/pocketbase"
scripts.build: concurrently --raw "npm run build --prefix apps/web" "npm run build --prefix apps/api"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --raw "npm run start --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/pocketbase"
scripts.lint: concurrently --raw "npm run lint --prefix apps/web" "npm run lint --prefix apps/api"
scripts.type-check: concurrently --raw "npm run type-check --prefix apps/web" "npm run type-check --prefix apps/api" 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test: concurrently --raw "npm run test --prefix apps/web" "npm run test --prefix apps/api" 2>/dev/null || true
